name: Blueprint (Premium)
text:
This blueprint contains information regarding the raw and rare materials, tools, and steps required to craft an item of premium rarity. Over the course of 1 hour, which can be done during a short rest, a character can attempt to learn the blueprint. If they do so, they must make a DC 14 Intelligence check with the appropriate tools. On a success, the blueprint for the item is learned. On a failure, the blueprint is not learned, and the character must wait 24 hours before they can try again.

_Blueprints contain the secrets of how to craft items of a more complex nature._
